subject.name: Introduction to business laws
subject.course_or_branch: BA in Socialogy Psychology Political Science

content: Meaning and scope of Business Law, Overview of the legal
environment in business (private and public law)., Role of Business
Law in protecting businesses, employees, consumers, and society

chapters.chapter_name: The Legal System and Sources of Business Law
content: Structure of the Indian legal system (courts, legislative bodies
executive agencies)., Sources of business law: statutory law, case
law, administrative regulations, and common law., The role of
judicial decisions in business law., Types of civil cases relevant to
business (contracts, torts, property)., Overview of criminal liability
in business (fraud, embezzlement)
The elements and types of contract, Contract execution
performance and breach., Remedies for breach of contract:
damages, specific performance, and rescission
Types of business entities: sole proprietorship, partnership
corporation, and limited liability company (LLC)., Advantages and
disadvantages of each business structure., Liability issues in
different business entities., Legal requirements for forming a
business entity

chapters.chapter_name: Intellectual Property (IP) and Its Importance to Business
content: Overview of intellectual property: patents, trademarks, copyrights
and trade secrets., The legal framework for protecting business
innovations and ideas., How businesses can leverage IP for
competitive advantage., Start-up and IP Laws
Understanding the concept of Business Ethics., Legal compliance:
ensuring adherence to laws and regulations in business operations
Corporate social responsibility (CSR) and its legal implications
Ethical challenges in business law (e.g., insider trading
environmental laws, labor rights)
